maya_sales: Eve (customer) asked for an air-gapped POC in their colo next month. Requirements: customer HSM signing, weekly minibundles, monthly full, no vendor key escrow. Thoughts?

ben_se: We support BYOK in Private. Best path: deliver unsigned minibundles + signing helper that runs inside customer network (pkcs11). Need HSM vendor and middleware details.

talia_infra: Packaging note: weekly diffs ok with chunking; pinned drivers inflate sizes. Preflight: disk space >=500GB, container runtime allowed, driver/kernel matrix.

sam_sec: Security must include SOW language: "Redwood will never receive or store private keys." Customer audit logs must remain local.

eve_cust: We'll run the tool in a jumpbox; using Luna HSM. Also want rollback runbook and per-minibundle handling fee estimate.

pkg-bot: created PKG-3001: signing-helper + Luna pkcs11 example + preflight checklist.

maya_sales: Action items: @ben_se prototype signing-helper + pkcs11 example, @talia_infra write preflight one-pager + size estimates, @sam_sec draft SOW clause. I'll follow up with a Fri sync invite. :thumbsup:
